name: TVForge Link
releaseNotes: First usable alpha companion with authenticated TV pairing, encrypted and replay-protected status/transfer/control, D-pad/Select/Back/Home remote actions, bounded text entry, signed-feed proposal, and foreground-only TVForge control.
description: TVForge Link is the Android companion for TVForge on Google TV. It pairs over the local network with matching phrase and explicit TV approval, then uses encrypted replay-protected requests for APK transfer, job observation, signed-feed proposals, and a bounded TVForge-only remote. It does not require ADB, Accessibility, root, hidden APIs, or a cloud account in standard mode.
